overview: This 308-page file brings together postwar reports on Japanese intelligence in wartime China, including Army, Navy, police, and civilian networks, personnel, radio interception, and Allied surveillance. It also documents a Shanghai Japanese residents’ election, an American consular employee’s loyalty investigation, family repatriation appeals, detained fishermen, and proposed trade with Japan through 1949.
interest: Organization charts, personnel lists, translated Gendarmerie records, and eyewitness radio-monitoring testimony reveal how Japanese intelligence networks operated.
